title: Smart Licensing
levelTitle: Level 28 - Cisco IOS and IOS XE

cards.a: A licensing model that replaces PAK and license files with a central portal (CSSM) that manages entitlements across devices. Devices register with a token and report usage; Smart Licensing Using Policy (SLUP) is the latest model.

cards.q: How does a device use Smart Licensing?
cards.a: The device registers to CSSM with a token, entitlements are matched, usage is reported to the portal, call-home provides transport, and enforcement follows policy.

cards.q: Which transport channels can Smart Licensing use?
cards.a: Call-home from device to Cisco, HTTPS smart transport as the normal online path, offline via file, an HTTPS proxy, or direct internet.

cards.q: What is Smart Licensing Using Policy (SLUP)?
cards.a: SLUP is the policy-based model: devices enroll via CSSM, use license tags, run in a default 90-day evaluation period, and enforcement takes effect only after the evaluation ends.

cards.q: What are the network license tiers in Smart Licensing?
cards.a: network-essentials is the base tier, network-advantage is the full tier, and dna-essentials and dna-advantage cover DNA features. The tier is purchased per device.

cards.q: What are the steps to register a device to CSSM?
cards.a: Get a registration token from the portal, run license smart register idtoken TOKEN, the device registers, entitlements match, and usage is reported.

cards.q: Which commands verify a Smart Licensing registration?
cards.a: show license status diagnoses the registration state, show license summary shows entitlements, and show call-home checks the transport; license smart deregister removes the device.

cards.q: How do you handle a device with no internet access to CSSM?
cards.a: Use offline transport with files, or request a local license reservation with license smart reservation request local and complete it through the portal.

cards.q: How long is the default evaluation period in SLUP?
cards.a: 90 days for Smart Licensing Using Policy, as opposed to the 60-day evaluation typical of classic Licensing.

cards.q: A device shows Not Registered and no entitlements. What do you check?
cards.a: Verify the registration token is valid, check show license status for the registration state, and confirm call-home transport reaches CSSM so usage is reported and entitlements appear.
